title: Bilingual Portfolio
description: A static-first, privacy-first software-engineering portfolio — English and Thai — with no backend, no analytics, and no form that stores a visitor brief.

caseStudy.problem: I needed a public portfolio that could present real software work in two languages, without a backend, tracking script, or contact form that captures visitor data.
caseStudy.built: An Astro 5 static site with i18n routing at `/` and `/th/`, typed content collections that keep project records separate from chrome copy, and a contact handoff that opens a public GitHub issue instead of storing a brief.
caseStudy.result: Deploys as a fully static site. Visitors can scan work, capabilities, and an external inquiry path; bilingual parity is enforced by shared schemas and mirrored per-locale records.
